summary: Keep stdio as the default MCP transport and require explicit opt-in plus a loopback bind for HTTP mode.
reason: The MCP HTTP transport has no authentication or TLS boundary and previously defaulted to an all-interface :7777 bind whenever selected through a flag or environment variable.
validated_outcome: Tests and binary probes confirm default stdio opens no listener, HTTP without --allow-http exits with status 2, and non-loopback bind addresses are rejected.
